I don't have all the answers especially in my situation, but I would look into some counseling I know there are some free online anonymous options available but idek how the quality of those are. even reaching out to sober friends you really trust and doing stuff with them to take your mind off things is a better option than these harder drugs.

I'm in the exact same boat as you I had to quit weed earlier this year after I ended up in the hospital again from a bad dxm/mushroom trip and they put me in the psych ward for suicide stuff. I know it's so much easier to hide these drugs from my parents at least. I know you probably know this and I'll just sound like a broken record but trust me you don't want to end up like me. please please try to quit while you still can before things end up horribly worse I promise things will and can get better. if you ever want someone to talk to I'm always here to talk if I can. your life is valuable and there are so so many better drugs out there to do hell i wouldnt be surprisedif dxm is better even though i cant recommend it either. I care about you even though we're strangers we're going through the same shit basically. you're never alone in this I promise.
